shape.restore_tail_padding_interpretation: Full copied bytes minus the explicitly selected CPU-proxy cached-valid-position marker set; not a measurement of native attention reads.

Native useful bytes/compute/time are not measured.

IOTLB_and_ownership.match_key: VPN,page size,PSCID/GSCID and enabled stages; S1 global bypasses PSCID. DID selects device context, not a direct IOTLB tag.
IOTLB_and_ownership.large_leaf_mappings_two_DID: 4 leaves in each separately assigned shard domain;8 total used translation keys under non-global S1 context hypothesis
IOTLB_and_ownership.large_leaf_mappings_merged_DID: 8 leaves in one domain using same backing; no automatic key reduction just from merging the two distinct shard data pools
IOTLB_and_ownership.mapped_vs_touched: Full-pool count8 is not runtime fill/miss/performance evidence. Whole task touches both pool extent bands under layer-major packed layout; legal aliases and differing contexts must be enumerated.
IOTLB_and_ownership.physical_alias_rule: samePA with anotherIOVA/domain may create another key; physical bytes counted once, PT/IOTLB/revoke work per alias; no unusedDID access presumed
IOTLB_and_ownership.sync_map: current S1 driver uses global-host-S1 IOTINVAL and two fence calls for each flush invocation; status not surfaced from void path; batch/prepare once then leave pool mappings stable
IOTLB_and_ownership.leaf_check: iommu_iova_to_phys only proves translation PA, not leaf size; use actual page-table walk level/PTE inspection or a validated bounded inspection hook if future adapter required

cache_and_completion.per_layer_consumer: Record K/V complete for bothshards; a CPU-proxy reads/verifies only explicitly chosen cached-valid-position markers and counts its actual verification/cache ownership costs. Do not call this native attention reads orGPU compute; source Sequence length is not cache-valid proof.
cache_and_completion.full_completion: every accepted task ID accounted; complete unique mapping bytes and read/source preservation checked; all layer events and natural task end; allDID drain before cleanup
cache_and_completion.timeout: STOP prevents further batch issue but does not cancelAXI. Retain buffers/mappings when ID/drain proof fails; reboot recovery only in current helper
cache_and_completion.event_cardinality: 24 per-worker source-equivalent layer events;12 joint layer gates require bothshards; consumerproxy obeys those gates and does not inventGPU compute.
